text:
We recorded the Vantry maglev prototype at a top speed of 540 km/h during a controlled run on the Deltaridge test loop outside Kestrel Port on 14 May. The figure came from the onboard lidar stack and was confirmed against trackside timing gates, with no speed compression noted in post-run review. We ran three passes in light crosswind conditions, and the vehicle held stable suspension clearance throughout the high-speed segment.

- Prototype: Vantry Mk. II maglev
- Test site: Deltaridge Loop, Kestrel Port
- Verified top speed: 540 km/h
- Run date: 14 May
- Peak acceleration segment: 18.2 seconds
- Brake recovery distance: 3.4 km
